- :warning: added the new `Confirmed` enum value to the `action_plans/items/status` response property for the response status `200`
- :warning: added the new `Draft` enum value to the `action_plans/items/status` response property for the response status `200`

-  api operation id `get_action_plans` was added
-  added the new optional `query` request parameter `filter[remediationOwner][id]`
-  added the new optional `query` request parameter `ids`
-  added the non-success response with the status `500`
-  added the optional property `action_plans/items/effective_remediation_extension_duration` to the response with the `200` status
-  added the optional property `action_plans/items/integration_url` to the response with the `200` status
-  added the optional property `action_plans/items/title_description` to the response with the `200` status
-  the response property `action_plans/items/external_integration_url` became required for the status `200`
-  the `is_flattened` response's property default value `false` was removed for the status `200`
-  the `pending_remediation_due_date_count` response's property default value `0.00` was removed for the status `200`
-  added 'propertyNames' constraint to the `action_plans/items/field_data` response property for the status `200`
-  added 'propertyNames' constraint to the `action_plans/items/flattened` response property for the status `200`
-  added 'propertyNames' constraint to the `action_plans/items/scopes` response property for the status `200`
